description: This file contains utility functions and type definitions for managing global package installations, including resolving paths, detecting package managers, and cleaning up directories, specifically for the 'openclaw' package.

methods.name: normalizePackageTarget
methods.description: Trims whitespace from the package target string.

methods.name: isMainPackageTarget
methods.description: Checks if the given package target string equals 'main' (case-insensitive).

methods.name: isExplicitPackageInstallSpec
methods.description: Determines if the package target string is an explicit install specification based on URL or protocol indicators.

methods.name: resolveExpectedInstalledVersionFromSpec
methods.description: Extracts the version from a package spec string if it matches the package name and is a valid version.

methods.name: collectInstalledGlobalPackageErrors
methods.description: Checks the installed package version and presence of sidecar files, returning errors if mismatched or missing.

methods.name: canResolveRegistryVersionForPackageTarget
methods.description: Determines if the registry version can be resolved for a given package target.

methods.name: resolveGlobalInstallSpec
methods.description: Resolves the package install specification based on environment variables and target tags.

methods.name: createGlobalInstallEnv
methods.description: Creates an environment for global package installation, adjusting PATH and environment variables.

methods.name: tryRealpath
methods.description: Attempts to resolve the real path of a target, falling back to path.resolve.

methods.name: resolveBunGlobalRoot
methods.description: Returns the global node_modules path for Bun package manager.

methods.name: inferNpmPrefixFromPackageRoot
methods.description: Infers the npm prefix directory from a package root path.

methods.name: resolvePreferredNpmCommand
methods.description: Finds the preferred npm command path if available.

methods.name: resolvePreferredGlobalManagerCommand
methods.description: Resolves the command for a given package manager, preferring npm if applicable.

methods.name: resolveGlobalInstallCommand
methods.description: Returns the command and manager for global installation.

methods.name: normalizeGlobalInstallCommand
methods.description: Normalizes input to a ResolvedGlobalInstallCommand.

methods.name: resolveGlobalRoot
methods.description: Resolves the global root directory for a package manager.

methods.name: resolveGlobalPackageRoot
methods.description: Resolves the package root within the global directory.

methods.name: resolveGlobalInstallTarget
methods.description: Resolves the full target info for global package installation.

methods.name: detectGlobalInstallManagerForRoot
methods.description: Detects which package manager manages a given root directory.

methods.name: detectGlobalInstallManagerByPresence
methods.description: Detects package manager presence based on directory contents.

methods.name: globalInstallArgs
methods.description: Generates command-line arguments for installing a package globally.

methods.name: globalInstallFallbackArgs
methods.description: Generates fallback arguments for npm global install.

methods.name: cleanupGlobalRenameDirs
methods.description: Removes temporary renamed directories for a package in the global root.
